days.title: Paris halts navigation as the 1910 Seine flood builds
days.selection_basis: Manual Pass 2 source-led replacement; two linked references for core identity, original two alternate IDs preserved but not reverified.
days.primary_storytelling_angle: Explain why months of wet weather and saturated soils primed the Seine basin, and why river navigation halted on 20 January before the later crest.
days.alternate_storytelling_angle: Trace how floodwaters spread into Paris via surface streets, transit infrastructure and underground passages rather than claiming a single sudden river-wall failure.
days.verified_key_facts: On 20 January 1910, Paris suspended navigation on the rising Seine because boats could no longer pass under bridges; the broader flood developed over multiple days.
days.verification_note: Two reviewed sources identify the same event/date region; full measured-claims review pending. Independence: cross_institution
